The structural type of this segment — chapter, section, scene, etc. A value from the open [`gmeow:ContentSegmentType`](../classes/gmeow-ContentSegmentType.md) vocabulary.

Use [`gmeow:segmentType`](gmeow-segmentType.md) from [`gmeow:ContentSegment`](../classes/gmeow-ContentSegment.md) to [`gmeow:ContentSegmentType`](../classes/gmeow-ContentSegmentType.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

[`gmeow:ContentSegment`](../classes/gmeow-ContentSegment.md), [`gmeow:ContentSegmentType`](../classes/gmeow-ContentSegmentType.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to set a content segment's structural kind to one [`gmeow:ContentSegmentType`](../classes/gmeow-ContentSegmentType.md) value — chapter, section, scene; functional, one type per segment.

### Avoid when

- Avoid encoding the segment kind as a [`ContentSegment`](../classes/gmeow-ContentSegment.md) subclass ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)) and avoid asserting two types on one segment (it is functional).

### How to use

- Point the [`gmeow:ContentSegment`](../classes/gmeow-ContentSegment.md) at one [`gmeow:ContentSegmentType`](../classes/gmeow-ContentSegmentType.md) individual; pair with [`gmeow:segmentIndex`](gmeow-segmentIndex.md) for ordering and [`gmeow:segmentOf`](gmeow-segmentOf.md) for containment.
